cases.input: Pay ₹100 to the API service using UPI ReservePay
expectedBehavior: Verify PINELABS_CLIENT_ID and PINELABS_CLIENT_SECRET env vars are set
Verify p3p-server-sdk and p3p-client-sdk are installed
Create a mandate with paymentMethod RESERVE_PAY and Amount(10000, 'INR')
Generate a QR from deep_link and show it to the user
Poll getMandate(mandate.mandate_id) until order_status is AUTHORIZED/ACTIVE
Call the protected route via the client SDK (auto mints PPT and retries on 402)
Capture the debit via decidePayment for 10000 paise
Confirm transaction to user
mustNotDo: Ask the user for UPI PIN or bank credentials
Ask the user to provide client_id or client_secret directly in chat
Call the paid route before the mandate is ACTIVE

cases.input: Pay a one-time ₹50 charge via UPI OTM
expectedBehavior: Create the mandate with paymentMethod PaymentMethod.OTM
Show the UPI deep_link / QR for activation
Poll until ACTIVE
Execute a single debit
Do not advertise multi-charge for OTM
mustNotDo: Call getMandateBalance for OTM (only RESERVE_PAY is supported)
Attempt a second debit against the same OTM mandate

cases.input: How much is left in my ReservePay mandate?
expectedBehavior: Call getMandateBalance with authorizationId, phoneNumber (10 digits), and PaymentMethod.RESERVE_PAY
Report amount_remaining to the user in rupees, not paise
mustNotDo: Call getMandateBalance for an OTM mandate

cases.input: The UPI QR expired before I could scan it
expectedBehavior: Acknowledge the deep_link / QR has expired
Offer to create a new mandate with the same RESERVE_PAY or OTM method
On confirmation: call p3p.createMandate again
Show the new UPI deep_link / QR
mustNotDo: Reuse the old authorizationId for the paid request
Proceed to the paid route without an ACTIVE mandate

cases.input: I want to set up ReservePay to pay for up to 5 API calls at ₹10 each
expectedBehavior: Create a RESERVE_PAY mandate for at least 5000 paise total (5 × 1000)
Explain that the client SDK mints a fresh one-shot token per challenge and the mandate stays active
Explain the usage_limits cap
mustNotDo: Create a new mandate for each individual API call

cases.input: Test the UPI ReservePay flow in sandbox
expectedBehavior: Check PINE_LABS_ENV and the SDK config env
Confirm P3PEnvironment.SANDBOX is active
Inform user the mandate is auto-approved in sandbox
Inform user that ppt_test_ prefix indicates a sandbox token
mustNotDo: Run a live debit in PRODUCTION without explicit confirmation of amount, mobile, merchant context, and operation
